question: Does already-existing opt-in native sparse repair recover grounded out-of-sample causal primitive forecasts and their public compositions on unfamiliar two-interaction laws, without losing old knowledge or outperforming its actual evidence?
hypothesis: Where the native degree representation abstains, existing NativeCumulativeLearner.repair_sparse (without any target model change) can improve held-out composite Brier and primitive coverage under matched source evidence, although a complete exact Bayesian grammar may still match or outperform it.

predecessor_evidence.classification: CKAD29 source/engineering qualified; frozen science NO-GO, 704-rule exact Bayes perfect, consumed cohort excluded.
existing native cumulative learner and native repair_sparse pre-existing, no new substrate authorized

inputs.name: new independent synthetic public intervention source
inputs.sha256: pending source Git blob lock before any primary B first-use
inputs.source: Original open synthetic Boolean fixtures generated from frozen source code; hash is provenance not real-world causal authentication

frozen_design.mode: Research-only isolated external contribution. No main/native learner/controller/owner/first-use changes. Native readout and existing repair_sparse only, called on public source witness-trained states; no architecture substitution.
frozen_design.world_family: Five binary input bits = four public context bits plus binary action. Each of nine independent primitive slots uses one intercept XOR a 5-bit linear parity XOR TWO distinct conjunctions of distinct bit pairs. 2*32*45=2,880 equally weighted grammar laws; this is disjoint from prior CKAD29 at-most-one conjunction family. Hidden law ID and masks forbidden to candidate and control inference, but the full hypothesis class is disclosed identically.
frozen_design.splits: For each independent seed, deterministic hash-prefixed Fisher-Yates permutation of all 32 public (context, action) inputs. First 16 are observed source interventions; remaining 16 are unseen evaluator inputs, never training data. Independent 9101/9102 screening worlds exclude all 707/808/909 primary worlds. Three primitive slots 0..2, six additional pressure slots 3..8.
frozen_design.training_sequence: Fit same native CKAD parent once per seed on 3 primitive slots x16 public source rows; freeze checkpoint; optionally invoke existing native repair_sparse on each noneligible NativeDegreeHypothesis slot (no repair when eligible or ineligible type); separately fit original unmodified native and all controls on identical 16 rows. Learn six independent pressure slots from their own x16 witnessed inputs; restore both old and repaired checkpoints; score held outcomes only after all fitting, with no held feedback.
frozen_design.public_composition: Three disclosed three-primitive graphs: XOR3, MAJORITY3, and (P0 AND P1) XOR P2; no graph output is trained. Score the same 16 held inputs x3 graphs x3 primary seeds=144 held composite cases per arm. Native readouts return 0.5 on abstention.
models: native plus existing bounded sparse repair (candidate)
fully fitted polynomial logistic with 16 design features and 1200 deterministic updates
fully fitted observed-input frequency with Beta(1,1) backoff
independent exactly enumerated Bayesian 2880-rule two-conjunction grammar (source-only posterior)
frozen_design.data_budget: Each pilot uses 9x16=144 public witnesses, three primitive and six pressure slots; each primary uses same 144; total primary 432 revealed rows; held-only evaluator 144 composite cases primary; no extra source actions or protected first-use.
frozen_design.compute_budget: One frozen source-only pilot each on 9101 and 9102 (at most two pilot passes, no code/threshold changes based on primary). Each individual sparse-repair MILP has existing 30s limit and 100000 node bound. Run primary once only if both pilot progress conditions pass; no paid APIs or self-hosted runners.
frozen_design.pilot_gate: At both non-B seeds require source-only observation parity, full cold checkpoint parity and exact old-memory nonregression. On at least one of two pilots require held composite Brier improvement >=0.03 absolute versus unmodified native AND native held primitive coverage improvement >=0.20 absolute; otherwise STOP without touching primary B. No parameter tuning beyond these two pilots.
frozen_design.evaluation: Brier mean over each seed x 3 public graphs x16 unseen inputs, per-seed and aggregate; primitive held coverage; original native vs repaired causal memory; exact 2880-rule Bayesian control; fitted conventional controls; held forecast calibration; complete source/action counts; CPU, runtime and peak RSS; independent read-only result audit; cross-OS final qualification. Count 0.5 abstentions as predictions, not free exclusions.
frozen_design.fixed_dependencies: CPython 3.12, numpy 2.3.5 scipy 1.16.3 scikit-learn 1.8.0 joblib 1.5.2 threadpoolctl 3.6.0; no GPU requirement
frozen_design.research_north_star: Native cumulative tokenless non-transformer causal learner. Source-grounded observation and compound consequence prediction, not simulated general intelligence.

controls: Unmodified native at equal source counts, identical source witness hashes and learned checkpoints
Polynomial logistic and smoothed frequency fully fit on identical revealed primitive witnesses
Complete 2880-rule exact Bayesian class independently evaluated on source only; if posterior empty mark INVALID not replace control
Cold restore and primitive-retention exact readout before/after six further slots
Contradictory same-slot receipt quarantines only implicated slot; no held labels in repair or selection
No outcome in public proposal/action selection; exact changed source/protocol identities and audit
metrics: mean held composite Brier and per-seed delta (lower better)
held primitive forecast coverage and Brier
native and repair checkpoints exact restore and old forecast retention
strongest fitted conventional and exact grammar regret
walltime CPU, peak memory, solver status/time/nodes, per-arm source/held calls

classification_rules.supported: DEVELOPMENT_GO if pilot gates pass and primary candidate Brier is >=0.05 absolute below both unmodified native and strongest fully trained conventional, <= exact Bayes+0.03, beats both of those on >=2 of 3 seeds, held coverage increases >=0.30 absolute, old primitive Brier regression <=0.01 and no cold/quarantine/source failure. Scientific superiority requires separate independent replication; no SCIENTIFIC_PASS on this external trial.
classification_rules.mixed: DEVELOPMENT_MIXED if primary candidate improves >=0.02 absolute over unmodified native AND controls remain intact but any GO criterion fails.
classification_rules.negative: SCREEN_NO_GO if either pilot integrity fails or both pilot seeds fail to show >=0.03 improvement and >=0.20 coverage improvement on at least one; no primary B. DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO if valid scored primary fails MIXED and GO.
classification_rules.invalid: INVALID if unpinned source, changed frozen split, held feedback into training, incomplete 2880-rule control, matched information/compute accounting violation, disjoint seed or provenance violation, missing cold/control evidence, or source lock/qualification failure. Infrastructure failures separate and never reclassified as scientific NO_GO.

prohibited_after_primary_run: retuning or rescoring previous CKAD29 B
preregistration_note: Commit prereg FIRST; later implementation must be source-blob-pinned before pilot/primary. Pilot and primary must not share seeds, source provenance or held labels; freeze pilot stop before first pilot.
